channel.title: Wire — Frontend
channel.description: Frontend from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Canvas UI Ships 35 HTML-in-Canvas Components That Run WebGL and WebGPU Effects Over Live DOM
item.description: Canvas UI is an open-source component library created by David Haz, utilizing the experimental HTML-in-Canvas API. It features 35 components that render GPU effects on live page content while maintaining accessibility. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Parsing Expression Grammar vs. regexes: Building Org parser in Lisp that exports to HTML (via SXML)
Plotly.js 4: A Big Update for the Popular Charting Library
item.description: Release notes for plotly.js 4.0 and plotly.py 7.0. Every single new feature, fix, and change to the defaults, complete with before and after examples. (2 sources: frontendfocus, javascriptweekly)

item.title: WebKit Features for Safari 27.0
item.description: Our Safari release notes have never been as long as they are for this version. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: its new MCP server
item.description: Update: In Safari 27 and Safari Technology Preview 247, we’re introducing the Safari MCP server — a Model Context Protocol server for web developers that makes your web development and debugging workflow faster and more powerful. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: 12 CSS Features You Can Use Today with No Build Step
item.description: Modern CSS features that replace Sass, PostCSS plugins and JavaScript hacks: nesting, :has(), container queries, subgrid and more, checked in September 2026. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Blurry Before Beautiful: Image Previews for the Web?
item.description: Showing blurry previews while images are loading on the web is a very common pattern which we'd love to standardize at the browser level, so that all developers can use it with very little code and complexity. Let us know what you think! (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Chrome's latest DevTools update
item.description: DevTools MCP server updates, Ad script tracking in the Ads section in Application, and Full soft navigation support in Performance. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Automatically detecting AI text in my browser
item.description: Automated AI text detection is currently an underserved niche. The only game in town is Pangram, which does an excellent job but desperately needs more… (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Runtime Lab — Learn Backend & Systems Engineering by building real software from scratch
item.description: Hey everyone, With the heavy shift toward AI codegen tools, I realized a lot of us (myself included) are starting to lose touch with core, low-level engineering fundamentals. (1 source: rprogramming)
